info.name: ABC Pharmacy — Salesforce REST API
info.description:
REST API endpoints for the ABC Pharmacy Salesforce project.

Setup:
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your org's instance URL.
2. Run the 'Get Access Token' request — it auto-populates the token.

Org Instance URL: https://orgfarm-7e74891727-dev-ed.develop.my.salesforce.com

variable.description: Populated automatically by the Auth request

exec: console.log('Access token set. Instance URL:', json.instance_url);

request.description:
Authenticates via Salesforce OAuth2 username-password flow.
The test script auto-stores the access token and instance URL into collection variables.

Replace <password+securitytoken> with the user's password concatenated with their security token.

Returns all Pharmacy Products that have stock available (abc_Available_Quantity__c > 0), sorted alphabetically by name.

**Authentication:** Bearer token required.

**Success Response — 200 OK:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "count": 2,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "a01bm000001XxxxAAA",
      "name": "Amoxicillin 250mg",
      "sku": "SKU-AMOX-250",
      "unitPrice": 35.0,
      "availableQuantity": 100
    },
    {
      "id": "a01bm000001XyyyAAA",
      "name": "Paracetamol 500mg",
      "sku": "SKU-PARA-500",
      "unitPrice": 15.0,
      "availableQuantity": 200
    }
  ]
}
```

**Error — 500 Internal Server Error:**
```json
{ "success": false, "error": "<message>" }
```

item.name: POST /abc/cart — Create Cart (Registered Customer, by SF ID)

request.description:
Creates a Pharmacy Order with line items for a registered customer.

**Request Fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| externalCartId | String | No | Unique cart ID from Ionic app — enables idempotency |
| customerId | String | No | Salesforce record ID of abc_Customer__c |
| guestFirstName | String | No | Guest first name (if no customerId) |
| guestLastName | String | No | Guest last name |
| governorate | String | No | Must match a valid abc_Governorate_values picklist entry |
| city | String | No | Must match a valid abc_City_values picklist entry |
| email | String | No | Order contact email |
| phone | String | No | Numeric phone digits (stored as number in org) |
| detailedAddress | String | No | Full address text |
| items | Array | **Yes** | At least one item required |
| items[].productId | String | **Yes** | Salesforce ID or abc_SKU__c value |
| items[].quantity | Integer | **Yes** | Must be > 0 |

**Idempotency:** Sending the same `externalCartId` twice returns HTTP 200 with the existing order.

**Success — 201 Created:**
```json
{ "success": true, "orderId": "a02bm000001ZxxxAAA", "orderNumber": "ORD-0001" }
```

**Idempotent — 200 OK:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Cart already exists.", "orderId": "...", "orderNumber": "ORD-0001" }
```

**Error Responses:**
- `400` — Empty/null items, blank productId, zero quantity, invalid customerId format
- `404` — Product not found by ID or SKU
- `422` — Requested quantity exceeds available stock
- `500` — Unexpected server error (logged to abc_API_Log__c)
